task: EXT-F-1003-T40 automatic page-load scrape behavior preparation

source_findings.setting_and_trigger: src/hooks/use-auto-scrape.ts reads scrapeAutoOnLoad and invokes captureWithFallback for the active HTTP(S) page after a 600ms settle delay.
source_findings.readback: ContextRulesComposerChip calls useAutoScrapeStore.getState().current internally when building the no-send preview. The store also has inFlight/current state, but neither is exposed through the rendered preview DOM or a native harness observation channel.
source_findings.default_context_shape: src/lib/chat/context/shape-config.ts defaults to v2-bundled. That builder can expose page_full_content when a trustworthy scrape exists, but does not expose scrape provenance. scrape_source is emitted only by legacy v1-flat, whose source explicitly says new keys belong in v2-bundled.
source_findings.missing_trigger: A native runner can observe rendered Page content when present, but current UI does not distinguish auto-background capture from manual capture, does not expose preview measurement/readiness when the Page content row is absent, and does not expose whether an auto capture is in flight or cached for the active document. Therefore no honest ON/OFF forcing helper can assert the required distinctions against the existing rendered UI.

gaps: Expose safe, read-only T40 evidence through an existing UI or harness-accessible runtime surface: preview readiness/document identity, capture provenance, and active-document inFlight/current-cache state.
Then write forcing tests against a real controlled page-load and the actual ContextRules preview; no helper tests or native acceptance are claimed in this preparation.
No downstream capture acceptance, full-extension reload acceptance, or live product behavior is claimed here.
scope_note: The adapter-model helper and tests from 5967a7ca were removed because their required runtime fields are not exposed by the current app.
